fixed: The couples of the study were one grey crowd of men in suits; they are five couples now, each a man and a woman side by side, with 37 MARRIED COUPLES over them.
The plate of shares hung in the window over their heads; it comes down in front of them at the table.
notes: The drawer opens on his orange notebook as he stands; she turns from smug to surprise, then her jaw drops with shock lines (the one big reaction). His page: FIXED THE BOILER, 2 A.M., WALKED THE DOG IN THE RAIN. Each reads the other's, surprise softening. The kitchen lit in two halves, each lit only on their side. 1979 over the couples; WHO DOES IT? making breakfast to starting the arguments; HERS and HIS sliding onto one plate and spilling over its rim; the two pointing in a fight; NO MORE NUMBERS / JUST A MARK ON A LINE; you in the crowd; the two of them at the table, the faces softening to a smile; the camera pulls back on the whole house.
